title: UH61 Fluted Wall Panels (WTCL cladding)
jurisdiction: Canada — national CCMC product evaluation; comparative attachment only, not a Calgary/Edmonton or Alberta project application

facts.text: The report describes 196.5 mm WTCL planks attached with aluminum clips over furring, creating at least a 10 mm unobstructed air space.
The NBC 2020 opinion classifies fastener size/spacing 9.27.5.4 and vinyl-siding provision 9.27.12.1.(1) as Alternative.
facts.locator: CCMC 14734-R PDF, p. 2, Compliance opinion table

facts.text: The fire table reports FSR 110 and SDC 445 under CAN/ULC-S102:2018, but the report says this additional-performance data is outside the CCMC opinion.
facts.locator: CCMC 14734-R PDF, p. 8, Fire performance table and note

facts.text: Conditions limit the product to Part 9 buildings and require at least 10 mm continuous vented air space, furring and fire blocking at each floor level.
facts.locator: CCMC 14734-R PDF, p. 4, Conditions and limitations

limitations: The report limits use to Part 9 buildings and specific installation conditions.
The fire result is additional performance data, not an independent project fire determination.
